mechanism: Prednisone may increase minocycline levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and increases infection/autoimmune complication risk; minocycline can cause photosensitivity and CNS effects potentially exacerbated by corticosteroids.
action: Monitor for increased minocycline adverse effects; ensure adequate sun protection; counsel on signs of infection given immunosuppression from prednisone; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring is warranted.
